title: Ti-Ping Tien-Kwoh: The History of the Ti-Ping Revolution, Volume I
coverage: A contemporary sympathetic account of the Taiping movement's founder, religious and political formation, recruitment, organization, early conflict, proclamations, and rapid territorial rise

title: Ti-Ping Tien-Kwoh: The History of the Ti-Ping Revolution, Volume II
coverage: A contemporary sympathetic account of the Taiping movement's military reversals, foreign intervention, internal defections, shrinking territory, fall of its cities, defeat, and retrospective explanations

title: Paris under the Commune
coverage: A hostile contemporary eyewitness account spanning the Commune's seizure of power, political organization, social response, conflict with Versailles, final fighting, collapse, and immediate aftermath

title: The Rise of Democracy
coverage: A historical survey of British Chartism, including the People's Charter, working-class mobilization, petitions and demonstrations, strategic division, failure to win its immediate program, and longer political legacy

title: General History of Africa VII: Africa under Colonial Domination 1880-1935 (Abridged Edition)
coverage: A multi-author African history of the Maji Maji movement's causes, ideology and mobilization, armed resistance, colonial counteroffensive, famine and demographic losses, defeat, and religious legacy
